comparison.objective: Candidate locks a gripper opening stop at a target angle; PR-1026 tightens a tourniquet to target pressure and locks its windlass.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires concentric driver-and-wrench countertorque; PR-1026 requires winding a tensioned strap and snapping a rod into a clip.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate verifies angle retention through three cycles; PR-1026 verifies gauge pressure, clip engagement, and hand clearance.
comparison.reason: Both set and secure a target, but the force mechanisms and hardest tested manipulations are materially different.
